tagline: 美能达便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 美能达于1995年推出的便携相机。配备Minolta 28-70mm motorized zoom. Four elements in four groups. Max. aperture f/3.5-8.4.。使用Auto-loading, motorwind and rewind of DX-coded film (Automatic Film speeds: ISO 25-3200).。

specs.镜头: Minolta 28-70mm motorized zoom. Four elements in four groups. Max. aperture f/3.5-8.4.
specs.胶片/画幅: Auto-loading, motorwind and rewind of DX-coded film (Automatic Film speeds: ISO 25-3200).
specs.英文简介: The Riva Zoom 70W (also known as the Freedom Zoom Explorer 70W or in Japan as the Minolta Capios 25) was a compact camera with a wide-angle zoom lens introduced by Minolta in 1995.
